_doc: Identifier-PART query suite (proposal B1, docs/audits/20260927-oss-landscape-optimization-proposal.md). Each query names a PART of a camelCase / PascalCase identifier that one seed-data.json row carries (useLayoutEffect, terminationGracePeriodSeconds, windowSoftInputMode, ...), either as spaced words ('layout effect') or as a Pascal fragment ('LayoutEffect'). relevant_ids = every seed row carrying that identifier (structural ground truth, not a judgement call). Selection rule: a query was admitted ONLY if it scored R@10 = 0 on the pre-B1 tree (2026-09-27, main @ 209a8bd, production_hybrid) AND the query is not a whole FTS token of the relevant row (unicode61 indexes `useLayoutEffect` as one token, so 'LayoutEffect' is a case-sensitive substring of the row yet matches nothing) — so the suite measures identifier splitting and nothing else. Rejected at construction because they already hit on the pre-B1 tree: 'soft input mode', 'visible content position', 'IgnoreDifferences' (case-folds to the whole identifier), 'root margin' (in the prose), 'owner authentication biometrics', 'termination grace', 'busy buffers size' (snake_case — unicode61 already splits '_'). Run via benchmark/denoise-ab.mjs (suite identifier_parts). KNOWN FAILURE (R@10 = 0.000 today): the first attempt (2026-09-27, never merged: append every camelCase/PascalCase part to the indexed text, query `(whole OR "part phrase")`) took this suite to R@10 1.000 and was reverted before merge, because precision_hard_negatives P@10 fell 0.8497 -> 0.8112 on the benchmark:gate corpus (-0.0385 > 1/30; denoise-ab union corpus 0.811 -> 0.780). Cause, by name: suffix humps became standalone tokens and admitted rows into generic one-word queries — WatermelonDB/CockroachDB/DynamoDB -> 'db' (q19/q35), ElastiCache -> 'cache' (q6), UserNotificationService -> 'notification' (q11). A retry must hold both arms: this suite's recall AND the precision suite within 1/n.
